name: Doctor Boat Control Marine Intelligence V5.1
release_notes: Removed READY and EMERGENCY STOP from the global header.
Removed Propulsion Manager from the main navigation.
Added responsive scrolling and resizable windows for smaller Raspberry Pi displays.
Training simulator now supports mouse-wheel zoom, drag-to-pan and double-click reset view.
Moved Center Lead Bow/Aft tug stations farther from the vessel and separated tug-station markers from vessel securing points.
Tow lines now run from each tug to the correct attachment point on the vessel.
Improved securing-point label spacing and reduced overlap.
Added distinct simple target shapes for Container, Bulk Carrier, Tanker, General Cargo and Jack-up Barge.
Added TUG & BARGE target with rectangular barge, Y-bridle and towing tug.
Added a simplified Mina Zayed-inspired harbour training map with quays, breakwaters, channel and buoy line.
Updated UI toward a cleaner AI marine monitoring style.
Desktop shortcut automatically refreshes to the current V5.1 name, path and icon.
notes: V5.1 UI and training simulator update.
The Mina Zayed training map is a simplified representation and is not an official nautical chart for navigation.
